content: Signature Select is a brand of hand-crafted premium cigars owned by Top Shelf Cigar Co., a company based in Skippack, Pennsylvania. These cigars are meticulously manufactured at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The brand is distinguished by the company owner’s signature, which is prominently displayed on both the cigar band and the packaging box. The filler tobacco used in these cigars is a Nicaraguan-grown Cuban-seed blend known as Corojo ‘99, while the wrapper is made from a Colorado leaf. Each cigar is individually wrapped in cellophane and packaged in boxes containing 25 cigars.
